description_full:
WE'RE HIRING — LEGAL CONTENT CREATOR INTERNSHIP PROGRAMME
Hukumnesia through Nesia.Legal is looking for passionate and committed students to join our Legal Content Creator Internship Programme.
This is an opportunity to gain hands-on experience in the intersection of law, legal education, and digital content, while developing your professional skills and portfolio.
👤 WHO CAN APPLY?
* Active undergraduate students in semesters 1–7
* Able to work remotely (WFH)
- Highly committed, responsible, and proactive
- Graphic design skills are a plus
🎁 WHAT WE OFFER?
- e-Certificate
- Exclusive access to paid classes
- LinkedIn Recommendation
- Paid on a Project Basis
If you're passionate about law, content creation, and digital education, this is your opportunity to gain meaningful experience, expand your portfolio, and grow with Hukumnesia & Nesia.Legal.
📩 How to Apply
Send your CV to:
hukumnesiatraining@gmail.com
Subject: Intern Program - Name
